summary: Join our Strategic HR Management Training Course to master essential HR strategies. Elevate your career and contribute to your organization's growth and success
lede: Strategic HR management links people practices with organizational goals. For HR professionals aligning workforce decisions with business priorities, the training covers workforce planning, talent and succession frameworks, and human capital analytics. Participants practice identifying workforce gaps, using an HR Balanced Scorecard, and shaping performance-linked rewards and digital HR initiatives.
audienceIntro: This program is tailored for professionals who are responsible for the intersection of people and performance within their organizations.
prerequisites: Participants should have at least 2-3 years of experience in a human resources or management role. A basic understanding of organizational structures and standard HR processes (recruitment, payroll, performance) is required. No prior experience with advanced analytics or ISO standards is necessary, as these will be introduced during the course.
